title: analytics: the dimension-label pass returns raw ids for a relationship-path lookup dimension, and ignores the target object's nameField
body:
Found while building a metadata app on the published packages (downstream card: steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#47, which is held `pm:blocked` on this one). Reproduced on `@objectstack/*` 18.3.0; both producers are unchanged on `main` at `64551047`.

## What a dashboard shows

A dataset dimension that is a lookup renders the referenced record's **id** instead of its display name in two shapes:

| Shape | Dataset dimension | Rendered | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| A — relationship-path lookup | `field: 'crm_account.owner_id', type: 'lookup'` on base object `crm_cb_order` | `2U7Cm35fLdREuo8pXHKHOOsl3vlogK8M` | the user's name |
| B — base-field lookup to an object whose title is its `nameField` | `cb_order` → `crm_cb_order` (`nameField: 'order_number'`, an autonumber; the object has no `name`/`title`/`label` field) | `vML9bIeq1IvEjAjw` | `SO-2026-0002` |

Control on the same door, same request: base-field lookups to objects that have a `name` field resolve (`customer` → `crm_account` gives company names, `grade` → `crm_carbon_grade` gives `N330`), so the label pass is live; the two failures are its path gap and its nameField gap.

## Producers

- **A** — `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts:435` `const meta = fields[dim.field];` looks the dimension up on the **base** object's field map only. A dotted relationship path finds no field meta, the loop `continue`s, and the raw FK id is served. The sort-key pass has the same base-only lookup (`metaFor`, same file ~line 210).
- **B** — `pickDisplayField` (`dimension-labels.ts:513-524`, used by `plugin.ts:1100` `fetchRecordLabels`) picks `name`/`title`/`label`, else the **first text field**. It never reads the target object's declared `nameField` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` — "the stored field used as the record display name"). On `crm_cb_order` the first text field is the platform-injected `queue` (null on every row), so no label is found and the id is served.

Spec side: `DatasetDimension.field` is documented as a field **or a relationship path** and `type` admits `'lookup'` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts:294-307`); there is no display-field key on a dimension. So an app author has no declared way around this, and must not invent one (a denormalized copy field or a path-to-text dimension would hide the gap in every app that copies it).

## Repro (18.3.0)

```
POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query
{ "datasetName": "cb_order_metrics",
  "selection": { "dimensions": ["rep"], "measures": ["order_tonnes", "order_count"] } }
→ rows: rep = "2U7Cm35fLdREuo8pXHKHOOsl3vlogK8M" …   (dimensionFields.rep = "crm_account.owner_id")

POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query
{ "datasetName": "cb_plan_metrics",
  "selection": { "dimensions": ["order", "plan_name", "approval_status"], "measures": ["plan_margin"],
                 "runtimeFilter": { "verdict": "below_floor" } } }
→ rows: order = "vML9bIeq1IvEjAjw"   (= SO-2026-0002 via GET /api/v1/data/crm_cb_order)
```

Same in the Console dashboards (table tiles render the ids).

## Every position in the family (one fix should close all)

- A: `crm_account.owner_id` as "By Sales Rep" (orders dataset) and as "Grades by Sales Rep" (customer-grade dataset); `cb_order.carbon_grade` as "Margin by Grade" (plan dataset) — a dotted path again, renders grade ids.
- B: `cb_order` → `crm_cb_order` as the "Order" column of "Plans Needing Special Approval".

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

- A: resolve a dotted reference dimension by walking the path to the hop object's field meta (the compiler already resolves the hop for SQL), in both the label pass and the sort-key pass.
- B: `pickDisplayField` prefers the target object's declared `nameField` before the `name`/`title`/`label`/first-text heuristic.
- Both keep grouping by id, so two people with the same display name stay separate, and keep the existing target-scope (exposure) check on the label read.

Dedupe words: dimension label relationship path · pickDisplayField nameField · resolveDimensionLabels dotted field · lookup dimension raw id dashboard.
